name: Noctis Blade heals for 100% of the damage dealt, not the reported ~13% (#4697)
contract: Report #4697 (2026-09-22T11:03:25Z): 'dealt 153 damage with Noctis Blade but only got healed for 20 health' (~13%). The reporter's own Core revision has PR #4676's merge commit (which fixed this exact ratio, Fixes-family commit 3352a459d) as an ancestor, so the report was filed against a build that should already carry the fix; this scenario re-verifies the live worktree independently of that history reasoning. AscensionWitchHunterAbilities.cpp's Hit() reads the heal percent from the live passive 574336 ('Noctis Blade Heal Passive') Effect 0 (BasePoints 99 + DieSides 1 = 100 in Spell.dbc), not a hardcoded 50% or 25%, and casts 574337 with SPELLVALUE_BASE_POINT0 = dealt * percent / 100. 574337 is SPELL_DAMAGE_CLASS_NONE (AscensionWitchHunterCompletion.cpp converts its target to TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY and, alongside 574335, strips crit/caster/taken-damage modifiers and armor), so SpellHealingBonusDone and the crit roll leave the custom base value untouched: the caster's health gain should equal the cast's dealt damage exactly, not ~13% of it. The scenario measures the enemy's health loss and the caster's health gain with the same 'health' metric and asserts gain / loss = 1.0; the reported symptom would read close to 0.13.

steps.label: Wound the caster so the heal is not clipped
Damage dealt, as a negative health change
DISCRIMINATING: the caster heals for 100% of the damage dealt, not ~13%
